sentences.7.2 Hva gjorde du i Bergen?: 7.2 What did you do in Bergen?
Viola is writing an email to Synne.
sentences.Synne flyttet til Trondheim for to uker: Synne moved to Trondheim two weeks ago, because she is going to study there.
I hope you're doing well in Trondheim.
sentences.Nå er jeg hjemme etter en hyggelig tur t: Now I'm home after a lovely trip to Bergen.
I went there four days ago.
sentences.Jeg reiste med tog, og togturen var kjem: I travelled by train, and the train journey was brilliant!
sentences.Vi kjørte over fjellet, og jeg så mye va: We went over the mountains, and I saw lots of beautiful scenery.
In Bergen I met Mum and Dad.
One day we took the Fløibanen up to Fløyen.
sentences.Der var det fantastisk utsikt, og mamma: The view there was fantastic, and Mum and Dad treated me to dinner there.
sentences.Neste dag så vi Bryggen og Fisketorget,: The next day we saw Bryggen and the Fish Market, and we took lots of pictures there.
sentences.Mamma og pappa gruet seg litt til å reis: Mum and Dad were a little nervous about travelling to Norway, because they don't speak Norwegian or English.
sentences.Heldigvis reiste de hit likevel, og på F: Luckily they came here anyway, and something funny happened at the Fish Market.
sentences.Der kjøpte vi laks av en gutt, og han va: We bought salmon there from a young guy, and he was Italian!
We talked to him for a long time.
sentences.Det regner ofte i Bergen, og det regnet: It often rains in Bergen, and it rained every day, but that didn't matter.
sentences.Det var veldig hyggelig å være sammen me: It was really nice to be with Mum and Dad again.
sentences.Etter tre dager dro de hjem til Italia,: After three days they went home to Italy, but first they walked me to the railway station.
sentences.Det var litt trist å reise fra dem igjen: It was a little sad to leave them again.
sentences.På toget ble jeg kjent med ei hyggelig e: On the train I got to know a nice elderly lady, and I showed her the pictures from Bergen.
sentences.Jeg tenkte på familien i Italia og på de: I thought about my family in Italy and about the family I live with here in Norway, and I was happy again.
sentences.Jeg har en familie her og en familie der: I have a family here and a family there, and that's really nice.
sentences.Jeg legger ved to bilder her i mailen, o: I'm attaching two pictures to this email, and I'm looking forward to showing you all the pictures, Synne. Talk to you again soon.
